Remark
[Tangential and normal decomposition]

Source: petersen:page-0110 ↗ thm:pet-ch3-radial-curvature-equation

1. ch3:3.2.3The third formula of item 3 computes a suitable curvature using only gradients of functions and Lie derivatives — no covariant derivatives are needed. The next two fundamental equations, known as the Gauss equation and the Peterson–Codazzi–Mainardi equation, use the notation $X=X^\top +X^\perp =X-g(X,N)N+g(X,N)N$ decomposing a vector into parts tangential and normal to a hypersurface $H$ with normal $N$.
